reviews.review: Pretty standard hack n' slash. But if you like 40k it's definitely worth it.

Quite an underrated game. While certaintly not the best title out there, it is definitely a diamond in the rough. It gives an almost spot on potrayal of the 40k universe, making it very engrossing to play, one of this game's strongest points. The quick melee-to-ranged combat makes for a simple but fun gameplay experience. Sad to see THQ go, and Relic's vision for Space Marine 2 and possibly 3 go down the drain. Pick it up if you're a fan of the universe, for the God Emperor.

Don't by this game if you just plan on playing the campaign like I did. The story is very so-so, and the gameplay is extremely generic and boring and it just drags on and on. The only really feeling of joy I got from the campaign was during the jump pack sections (Which are relatively rare). 
If you're looking for a semi competent third person shooter multiplay and are okay with no cover system this may be the game for you. Just don't expect it to ever be competative because the game also lacks dedicated servers.
